card.what: Speech-to-text API model by OpenAI for transcribing recorded audio files and realtime audio streams.
best_at: transcribing recorded meetings, calls and interviews
transcribing live audio streamed over a websocket
picking up domain-specific terms from keyword hints
transcribing multilingual or code-switched audio
not_for: identifying who spoke when (no built-in speaker diarization)

card.what: Text-to-speech API model by OpenAI, built on GPT-4o mini, that turns text into spoken audio.
best_at: narrating text with a chosen preset voice and tone
reading out short instructions or notifications aloud
steering delivery style with plain-language instructions
producing speech for realtime voice apps
product_uses: voice assistant that reads back replies
not_for: holding a spoken conversation (it only speaks, it does not listen)
cloning a specific person's voice from a sample

card.what: Realtime speech-to-speech model by OpenAI for building voice agents that hold live spoken conversations.
best_at: holding a live spoken conversation with natural interruption handling
calling tools and functions mid-conversation
acting as a voice agent for customer support calls
reasoning through multi-step spoken requests
product_uses: realtime voice agent for a website widget
not_for: transcribing a prerecorded audio file (built for live sessions, not batch files)
long-form text writing outside a live conversation

card.what: Speech-to-text API model by ElevenLabs for transcribing recorded audio with word-level timestamps.
best_at: transcribing recorded meetings, calls and interviews
labelling who spoke when in a recording
producing word-level timestamps for subtitles
picking out names and terms with keyterm prompting
product_uses: subtitling tool for videos and podcasts
not_for: live transcription while someone is talking (this version is for recorded audio)

card.what: Text-to-speech API model by ElevenLabs for expressive, emotionally nuanced spoken audio.
best_at: narrating audiobooks and documentaries
voicing game and film characters with emotional range
directing delivery with inline tags like whispering or shouting
generating multi-speaker dialogue in one audio file

card.what: Speech-to-text API model by Deepgram for transcribing recorded and streaming audio.
best_at: transcribing live streaming audio for voice agents
transcribing recorded calls and meetings in batch
adapting to custom vocabulary without retraining
redacting personal information from a transcript

card.what: Text-to-speech API model by Deepgram built for enterprise voice agents.
best_at: voicing customer support and IVR phone agents
producing natural pacing for business conversations
responding with low-latency speech in a voice agent pipeline
choosing among many enterprise-toned voices
product_uses: voice agent for a contact center
not_for: narrating audiobooks with cinematic emotion (built for business use, not entertainment)

card.what: Speech-to-text API model by AssemblyAI for transcribing recorded and streaming audio.
best_at: transcribing calls that switch between languages mid-sentence
picking up rare words and domain-specific terminology
labelling who spoke when in a recording
detecting turn-taking for voice agent pipelines

card.what: Text-to-speech API model by Cartesia for fast, natural streaming speech generation.
best_at: generating low-latency speech for realtime voice agents
pronouncing confirmation codes and heteronyms correctly
matching pacing and intonation to the context of a script
streaming speech as text arrives token by token
product_uses: realtime voice agent for a website widget
not_for: holding a spoken conversation (it only speaks, it does not listen)

card.what: Realtime speech-to-speech model in the Gemini API for low-latency spoken conversations and voice agents.
best_at: holding a live spoken conversation with natural turn-taking
responding to a user's emotional tone in conversation
calling tools and functions during a live voice session
reasoning through multi-step requests mid-conversation
product_uses: realtime voice agent for a website widget
not_for: transcribing a prerecorded audio file (built for live sessions, not batch files)
long-form text generation outside a live session
